title: Non-Routine Supply Markup and Oxygen Concentrator Rates by Tier (Ancillary and Optional Services Billing)
content:
Two rates of Ancillary and Optional Services Billing vary by ancillary account tier: the markup over the center's acquisition cost for non-routine medical supplies billed to the resident (a percent; 0 where the payer covers supplies), and the monthly charge for an oxygen concentrator for a resident whose payer does not cover it (USD; 0 where covered).

| Ancillary account tier | Non-routine supply markup over acquisition cost | Oxygen concentrator, per month |
|---|---|---|
| Ancillary Account, Medicare Part A Consolidated Billing | 0 percent | USD 0.00 |
| Ancillary Account, Medicare Part B | 0 percent | USD 185.00 |
| Ancillary Account, Medical Assistance | 0 percent | USD 0.00 |
| Ancillary Account, Private Pay | 25 percent | USD 185.00 |
| Ancillary Account, Medicare Advantage | 0 percent | USD 0.00 |
| Ancillary Account, Hospice Election | 0 percent | USD 0.00 |

## Reading the rates

- The markup is above 0 percent in one tier only, Ancillary Account, Private Pay, at 25 percent.
- The oxygen concentrator charge is USD 185.00 in two tiers, Ancillary Account, Medicare Part B and Ancillary Account, Private Pay, and USD 0.00 in the other four.
